_note: Outpost keepers and residents (SGODOT-227). Outfits from the catalogue parts, matched to the SGODOT-219 portraits (contact sheets: tools/dev/parts_contact_sheet.gd, lineup: tools/dev/npc_lineup.gd), accepted by the art director (wp-3d-scene); the keepers follow their SGODOT-224 keeper portraits too (Finn: brown hair under a beige bucket hat, hairhat51, approved on 227 after 韩信 int9). Old Kai, Mei and Ama wear the NPC-only parts from SGODOT-229, Sigrid, Finn and Pip those of the second batch on 227 (assets/avatar/npc_only.json): Kai's knit hat and beard (mask slot), Mei's headscarf and brown apron, Ama's bun; Sigrid's navy postal cap and uniform, Finn's grey-blue overalls, Pip's postal cap without the ponytail; players never get these. Rules: body00 / base rig only, uniform scale only (keepers 1.0, Pip 0.85-0.9), no animal or novelty hoods (hairhat20), no cloth28, no glasses, no bag except Pip, never the default hairhat0 + cloth0 + shoes0, no two NPCs share both hairHat and cloth. A name tag floats over every NPC. Lena, Rafa and Tomo (SGODOT-284, 2026-10-14; looks signed off by the UI lead, sent by the art director) are the agreed exceptions to the glasses and bag rules: Lena wears glass1, Tomo glass0 and messengerbag3. Tomo's darker hair (hairhat0_npc_tomo) and Granny Wu's grey bun (hairhat80_npc_granny_wu) are NPC-only parts of #407 (上官婉儿 / 刘备 on 284): Tomo is no longer the player's default look.
